children: BlackRock Health Sciences Term Trust's tender offer for up to 5% of outstanding shares expired November 18, 2026, and was oversubscribed. Accepted shares will be purchased at 98% of NAV as of November 19; final results and any proration factor are expected on or about that date.
Tender offer for up to 5% was oversubscribed
Demand exceeded the offer, so shareholders are expected to receive prorated acceptance rather than have all tendered shares purchased.
Purchase price set at 98% of Nov. 19 NAV
The 2% discount to NAV defines the repurchase price; the NAV-based dollar amount was not yet provided.
Final results and proration expected around Nov. 19
The final acceptance ratio will clarify how many shares are repurchased from each tendering shareholder.

This is the preliminary outcome of a specific share repurchase tender offer, not a report of broader operating performance. The final results and proration factor, expected on or about November 19, will establish the accepted share count.
